Basic chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Gemini response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"content":"Say hello in one word.","role":"user"}],"model":"vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash","temperature":0}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.chat(request).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
